summary: Backend and UI regression testing completed. Admin auth, dashboard, navigation, member/plan CRUD, settings access, notifications, lifecycle idempotency, member portal, and responsive UI passed; member OTP verification fails with HTTP 500.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 after valid OTP. Backend compares MongoDB's naive expires_at datetime with timezone-aware now(), raising TypeError.

minor.issue: CORS middleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True; explicit frontend origin is required for browser credentialed requests.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete verification because backend returns 500.

action_items: Normalize OTP expires_at to timezone-aware UTC or compare consistently before expiry validation.
Replace wildcard CORS origin with configured explicit frontend origin and retain credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: OTP endpoint has an unhandled naive-vs-aware datetime comparison causing a production 500.
CORS wildcard plus credentials is insecure and can prevent browser credentialed auth depending on origin handling.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST API plan and one TEST API Member during API testing; not deleted because no delete endpoint is implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI smoke passed at desktop/mobile. Re-run OTP flow after datetime fix, then validate browser cookie/CORS behavior from the configured frontend origin.
rca of the issue: request-otp stores aware UTC datetime via Motor/MongoDB; MongoDB returns it as naive on read. verify_otp line 187 compares record.get('expires_at') < now(), raising TypeError before token creation. Normalize both values to UTC-aware or compare epoch timestamps.
